name: Shards of Infinity
summary: Competitive sci-fi deck-building game where players recruit allies and champions to raise mastery to 30 or eliminate all opponents.
rules_text: Each player starts with 50 Health, 0 Mastery, and a 10-card deck. Shuffle and draw 5. Six cards from the center deck form a shared center row. On your turn: 1) Play Phase - play cards from hand to gain Gems, Power, Mastery and effects. Pay Gems to recruit Allies/Champions into discard, or fast-play Mercenaries from the row for immediate effect then they go to bottom of center deck. Exhaust Champions and your Character (once per turn each, pay 1 Mastery to gain 1 via Focus) for abilities. Use Power to destroy enemy Champions. 2) Attack Phase - assign remaining Power as damage among opponents. Defenders may reveal Shield cards from hand to reduce damage. Reduce Health accordingly; players at 0 or less are out. 3) End Phase - return fast-played mercenaries to center deck bottom, discard remaining hand and played Allies, reset Champions, draw 5. Replenish center row instantly. If you reach 30 Mastery you can win via Infinity Shard, otherwise last player alive wins.
rating_reason: Deckbuilding duel with hidden hands, sequential choices, arithmetic win
